QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Saving the Glacier 2
QuestInfo.1: Nora needs you to find out what the Black Wings are after. Defeat their Shaver Bots and collect 30 of the Glacial Cores they've harvested.
QuestInfo.2: You took down a number of Shaver Bots and brought samples back for Nora the Explorer. She believes the Glacial Cores they're harvesting have the power to create cold.
